name: CommRingCat.tensorProd_map_right
initialProofState:
R S : CommRingCat
inst✝ : Algebra ↑R ↑S

⊢ Eq ((R.tensorProd S).map f).right (CommRingCat.ofHom ↑(Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id ↑S ↑S) (CommRingCat.toAlgHom f)))
decl:
variable (R S) in
/-- The base change functor `A ↦ S ⊗[R] A`. -/
@[simps! map_right]
def tensorProd : Under R ⥤ Under S where
  obj A := mkUnder S (S ⊗[R] A)
  map f := Algebra.TensorProduct.map (AlgHom.id S S) (toAlgHom f) |>.toUnder
  map_comp {X Y Z} f g := by simp [Algebra.TensorProduct.map_id_comp]
